name: PLZ-05 self-propelled howitzer
overview_md:
The PLZ-05 is the People's Liberation Army's premier tracked self-propelled howitzer — China's modern 155 mm gun system and the heavy fist of its divisional and corps artillery. Entering service from around 2008, it replaced older 152 mm Soviet-pattern systems and brought the PLA's artillery up to NATO-standard 155 mm calibre with a long 52-calibre barrel and an automatic loading system.

The PLZ-05 fires standard 155 mm ammunition to around 40 km and farther with rocket-assisted projectiles, and is reported to be able to fire laser-guided and base-bleed rounds for precision and extended range. Its autoloader gives it a high burst rate of fire, and the system is integrated into the PLA's increasingly networked artillery reconnaissance-strike system, drawing targeting from drones and counter-battery radars.

For an analyst, the PLZ-05 is the conventional fire-support backbone behind China's manoeuvre forces — the system that would mass fires in a continental campaign on the Indian border or in support of an amphibious assault. It is less visible than missiles or fighters, but artillery remains the great killer on modern battlefields, and the PLZ-05 represents the PLA's effort to match Western and Korean self-propelled guns in reach, rate and precision.

armament_json.notes: Autoloader; rocket-assisted and guided rounds extend reach/precision

combat_history.event: No combat use; exercised across PLA combined-arms formations and deployed near the Indian border.
combat_history.significance: Capability assessed from exercises and fielding.

modernization.description: Integration with drones/counter-battery radar and guided ammunition.
modernization.impact: Improves responsiveness and precision of PLA artillery.

vulnerabilities.description: Vulnerable to counter-battery fire and loitering munitions if static.
Tube artillery is out-reached by rocket/missile systems like the PHL-191.

operational_patterns.typical_deployment: Massed divisional/corps fire support for manoeuvre forces; counter-battery; border and amphibious-support roles.
operational_patterns.typical_task_group: Combined-arms brigades with Type 99A/Type 15 and networked targeting.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: Comparable 155 mm/52-cal SPGs; the K9 dominates exports while the PLZ-05 equips the PLA at scale.
The PzH 2000 is the high-end Western SPG the PLZ-05 broadly emulates.
The U.S. SPG of the same role and calibre.

doctrine.role: Premier PLA 155 mm self-propelled howitzer providing massed, mobile fire support.
doctrine.employment: Autoloaded burst fire and counter-battery, networked with drones and radars for responsive fires.
doctrine.design_philosophy: Bring PLA artillery to NATO-standard 155 mm reach, rate and precision.
doctrine.threat_context: The conventional fire-support backbone behind manoeuvre forces on the Indian border and in amphibious support.
doctrine.comparison_frame: Read against the K9 Thunder, PzH 2000 and M109 Paladin.
